newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Greencore says Irish punt strength damaging.
newsitem.headline: Greencore says Irish punt strength damaging.

text.p: Greencore Group Plc said on Thursday that the strength of the Irish pound against European currencies and the revaluations of the Irish Green Pound has pressurised sugar margins.
Greencore said the effect of Irish pound strength was countered somewhat by the strengthening of sterling against the Irish pound and by other measures taken by the group.
Chairman Bernie Cahill told shareholders at an annual meeting that the Irish sugar processing campaign, which was completed in early January, produced some 227,000 tonnes of sugar during the year.

He said this comfortably exceeded Greencore's quota of 200,200 tonnes, in an efficient and satisfactory campaign which, he said, continued to benefit from the group's substantial capital expenditure programme over recent years.
"Overall, therefore, the group, while trading in a highly competitive environment, is in a strong position to continue its progress and to further add to shareholder value," Cahill said.
